personal.nav.label: Personal data sections
personal.list.intro: Requests to export or erase personal data, open ones first. A request is due 30 days after it was received.
personal.list.caption: Privacy requests
personal.list.pastEnd: There are no requests on this page.
personal.list.emptyBody: Requests from customers and requests you record for guests appear here. To record one, look the person up by email.
personal.list.noMatchBody: Choose another status or show all requests.
personal.lookup.intro: Find out what the shop holds for an email address: the account, the guest orders and the stored mails. The address is sent in the request body, never in the page address, and the lookup is recorded in the audit log.
personal.lookup.emailHint: Check that the person controls this address before you act on their behalf, for example by replying to a mail from it.
personal.lookup.issue.email_invalid: This does not look like an email address.
personal.lookup.done: Lookup finished. The result is below.
personal.lookup.nothing: The shop holds nothing for this address: no account, no guest order and no stored mail.
personal.lookup.guestOrdersNote: Orders placed with this address that belong to no account.
personal.lookup.noGuestOrders: No guest order has this address.
personal.lookup.noOpen: No open request for this person.
personal.create.title: Record a request
personal.create.intro: Record that this person asked for their data. The request has a due date and is kept as proof that it was answered.
personal.create.subject: Person
personal.create.subjectHint: By address: the guest orders and mails of the address, and the account that has it. By account: the account and, when its address is verified, the guest data of that address.
personal.create.subjectAddress: The email address you looked up
personal.create.noteHint: No personal data here: write only how you checked, for example "replied from the address". At most {max} characters.
personal.create.lost: No answer arrived, so the request may or may not have been recorded. Open the list of requests to check before you record it again.
personal.create.issue.account_missing: No account was found for this address.
personal.create.issue.note_too_long: The note is too long (at most {max} characters).
personal.create.issue.email_invalid: This does not look like an email address.
personal.detail.subject: Person
personal.detail.subjectEmail: An email address (only a hash of it is stored)
personal.detail.resultNote: Counts and codes only. The result never holds contact data.
personal.detail.emailAgainHint: The request keeps only a hash of the address, so type it again. It is sent in the request body.
personal.detail.previewFirst: Preview the erasure first: erasing is possible only when the preview shows nothing in the way.
personal.detail.issue.email_required: Enter the email address of the person.
personal.detail.issue.email_invalid: This does not look like an email address.
personal.result.ordersAnonymised: Orders whose contact data was erased
personal.notice.exportedCare: The file holds personal data. Send it only to the person who asked, over a channel you trust, and delete your copy afterwards.
personal.notice.erased: The erasure is done and cannot be undone.
personal.notice.erasedOrders.one: The contact data of {count} order was erased.
personal.notice.erasedOrders.other: The contact data of {count} orders was erased.
personal.notice.erasedNoAccount: There was no account to delete.
personal.notice.erasedLimits: Data that was already sent to mail, carrier or payment services, backups and server logs is not reached from here.
personal.notice.eraseUnconfirmed: The server answered, but the request is not marked as completed, so nothing is claimed. The request was read again; check its status.
personal.notice.lost.export: No answer arrived for the download. Nothing is repeated by itself. The request was read again; start the download again if you need the file.
personal.notice.lost.erase: No answer arrived for the erasure, so it may or may not have happened. The request was read again: if it is completed, it is done; if not, preview the erasure again before you try again.
personal.notice.lost.reject: No answer arrived for the rejection, so it may or may not have happened. The request was read again; check its status.
personal.preview.title: Preview of the erasure
personal.preview.nothingChanged: This is only a preview: nothing has been changed.
personal.preview.accountYes: Will be deleted, with its sessions, cart and sign-in tokens
personal.preview.ordersToAnonymise: Orders whose contact data will be erased
personal.preview.noBlockers: Nothing is in the way. You can erase now.
personal.preview.blockedBody: Settle these first (finish or cancel the order, wait for the payment, refund or shipment to finish), then preview again. Nothing has been changed.
personal.blocker.open_order: the order is still open (awaiting payment, or paid and not yet fulfilled or cancelled)
personal.blocker.payment_in_progress: a payment is still in progress
personal.blocker.refund_in_progress: a refund is still in progress
personal.blocker.mail_sending: a mail to this person is being sent right now (try again in about 2 minutes)
personal.blocker.unknown: something this version does not know yet is in the way
personal.refusal.erasure_blocked: The erasure is blocked and nothing was changed. These are in the way:
personal.refusal.request_closed: This request is already closed, so it cannot be changed again. It was read again.
personal.refusal.export_too_large: This person has too many orders for one download (the limit is 10 000). Nothing was exported.
personal.refusal.subject_not_found: The account of this request no longer exists, so there is nothing to act on. The request was read again.
personal.refusal.not_an_erasure_request: This is an export request, so it cannot erase anything. Record an erasure request instead.
personal.refusal.contact_erased: The contact data of this order was erased, so this action is no longer possible.
personal.refusal.subject_mismatch: This is not the address the request was recorded for. Nothing was done.
personal.refusal.rateLimited: Too many downloads in a short time. Wait a while and try again.
personal.refusal.rateLimitedWait: Too many downloads in a short time. Try again in about {minutes} min.
personal.erase.title: Erase the personal data
personal.erase.deletes: The account (if there is one) with its sessions, cart and sign-in tokens, and the stored mails to the address are deleted. The contact data of the orders (names, email, phone, addresses except the country, the guest link) is erased.
personal.erase.keeps: Order numbers, lines, totals, dates, payments, refunds and shipments stay as accounting records.
personal.erase.limits: Data already sent to mail, carrier or payment services, backups and server logs is not reached.
personal.erase.typedMismatch: The word does not match. Type it exactly as shown.
personal.reject.title: Reject the request
personal.reject.body: The request is closed without acting on it. Record why.
personal.reject.option.duplicate_request: The same request was already handled
